name: TankSeal
short_description:
Use for repairing any leak in plastic & metal water tank & coolers.

HOW TO APPLY
Ensure the tank is empty.
Dry the crack.
Clean the surface with a cloth to remove dirt and dust.
Roughen the surface with sandpaper (150 no).
Mix Part A and Part B.
Apply the mixture generously over the crack; apply both inside & outside.
Apply within 10 minutes.
Wait 2–3 hours before use.
